name: notifications
title: Notifications
summary: Users get an in-app inbox with an unread badge, push on their phones and optional email, and choose channels per kind.

env.name: EXPO_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.doc: Expo push access token; needed only when push security is on for the Expo project. Unset in development = pushes go to PUSH_SINK_DIR or the log.

env.name: PUSH_SINK_DIR
env.doc: Development without EXPO_ACCESS_TOKEN: write each push batch as a JSON file here instead of calling Expo.

env.name: NOTIFICATIONS_RETENTION
env.doc: Read inbox rows older than this are deleted (Go duration; unread rows are kept).

wire.insert: import { notificationsAdminNav, notificationsBell, notificationsHome, notificationsSession, notificationsSettings } from "./notifications/registry";

stitch: Register each kind your modules send with notifications.RegisterKind (ID, Label, default Push and Email). Unregistered kinds still deliver (push on, email off) but don't appear in preferences; leave a kind unregistered when its module emails on its own.
Give every notification a Link that is a route on both web and mobile; push taps and inbox rows open it.
Mobile push: run `eas init` (extra.eas.projectId), set up APNs/FCM credentials in EAS, and rebuild the dev client (the expo-notifications config plugin is wired into app.config.ts).
Decide placement on mobile: Inbox is a Home row; promote it to a tab only if notifications are a primary destination.
Show PushBanner where asking for push explains itself (after a first message or support request), never at launch.
Name Expo push (and your mail provider) as processors in the privacy policy (concrete/compliance.md).
